_about: Interconnects, sensors, fuses and BMS options. Resistivities are standard material values at 20 C; ratings, masses and costs are class estimates (assumptions), not quotes for specific parts.

busbars.name: Nickel strip 0.15 x 8 mm
busbars.source: Resistivity: pure nickel 6.99e-8 ohm*m at 20 C (handbook value). Link length = 21700 pitch + 1 mm gap. Ampacity, mass and cost per cell = class assumptions for spot-welded strip.

busbars.name: Copper busbar 0.15 x 10 mm
busbars.source: Resistivity: annealed copper 1.68e-8 ohm*m at 20 C (handbook value). Link length = 21700 pitch + 1 mm gap. Ampacity, mass and cost per cell = class assumptions for laser-welded Cu (Ni-plated tabs).

protection.name: 10 kOhm NTC thermistor
protection.source: Class estimate for a lugged 10k NTC with lead.

protection.name: 100 A blade/bolt-down fuse
protection.source: Rating from TASK.md §1.2; mass and cost = class estimates.

protection.name: 120 A pyro-fuse
protection.source: Rating from TASK.md §1.2; mass and cost = class estimates for a low-voltage pyro disconnect.

protection.name: Basic BMS (passive balancing)
protection.source: Class estimate for a 13-16S 100 A e-2W BMS board with 4 NTC inputs.

protection.name: BMS with fan PWM output
protection.source: Class estimate: basic BMS plus fan driver and 6 NTC inputs.

protection.name: Active BMS (active balancing, thermal-aware charging)
protection.source: Class estimate for a 120 A BMS with active balancing, 8 NTC inputs and temperature-dependent charge-current limits.
